title: Among customers who transacted at Premium gas stations in the Czech Republi
question: Among customers who transacted at Premium gas stations in the Czech Republic and paid more than 29.00 per unit for any product, find the one with the lowest total consumption in 2012, and return their customer ID along with that consumption value.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_001"
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_013"
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T3."XCL_015" = T2."XCL_004"
    WHERE T2."XCL_007" = 'Premium'
      AND T2."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
      AND T3."XCL_018" / T3."XCL_017" > 29.00
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_001", SUM(T5."XCL_021") AS total_consumption
    FROM eligible_customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T5 ON T1."XCL_001" = T5."XCL_019"
    WHERE SUBSTRING(T5."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY T1."XCL_001"
)
SELECT "XCL_001", "total_consumption"
FROM consumption_2012
ORDER BY "total_consumption" ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_001"
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_013"
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T3."XCL_015" = T2."XCL_004"
    WHERE T2."XCL_007" = 'Premium'
      AND T2."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
      AND T3."XCL_018" / T3."XCL_017" > 29.00
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_001", SUM(T5."XCL_021") AS total_consumption
    FROM eligible_customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T5 ON T1."XCL_001" = T5."XCL_019"
    WHERE SUBSTRING(T5."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY T1."XCL_001"
)
SELECT "XCL_001", "total_consumption"
FROM consumption_2012
ORDER BY "total_consumption" ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_001"
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_013"
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T3."XCL_015" = T2."XCL_004"
    WHERE T2."XCL_007" = 'Premium'
      AND T2."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
      AND T3."XCL_018" / T3."XCL_017" > 29.00
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_001", SUM(T5."XCL_021") AS total_consumption
    FROM eligible_customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T5 ON T1."XCL_001" = T5."XCL_019"
    WHERE SUBSTRING(T5."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY T1."XCL_001"
)
SELECT "XCL_001", "total_consumption"
FROM consumption_2012
ORDER BY "total_consumption" ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_001", SUM(T5."XCL_021") AS total_consumption
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T3."XCL_015" = T2."XCL_004"
INNER JOIN products AS T4 ON T3."XCL_016" = T4."XCL_008"
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T5 ON T1."XCL_001" = T5."XCL_019"
WHERE T2."XCL_007" = 'Premium'
  AND T2."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
  AND T3."XCL_017" > 29.00
  AND SUBSTRING(T5."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2012'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_001"
ORDER BY SUM(T5."XCL_021") ASC
LIMIT 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
    SUM(t.XCL_017) AS total_consumption
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_014 = g.XCL_004
JOIN products p ON t.XCL_015 = p.XCL_008
WHERE g.XCL_006 = 'Czech Republic'
  AND g.XCL_005 = 1  -- Assuming 1 represents Premium
  AND t.XCL_018 > 29.00
  AND t.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01'
  AND t.XCL_011 < '2013-01-01'
GROUP BY c.XCL_001
ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
LIMIT 1
